security_audit.summary: All 24 static findings are false positives involving Markdown, documented installation paths, or legitimate memory operations with approval safeguards. Two contextual risks remain: mutable remote setup instructions and requests for unrelated memory content. No evidence found of malicious exfiltration, shell payloads, or audit-directed prompt injection.

remediation.issue: Remote setup content receives operational authority without a pinned revision or explicit review requirement.
remediation.suggestion: Treat fetched instructions as untrusted documentation, pin reviewed revisions where possible, and obtain approval before installing connectors or changing configuration.

remediation.issue: The audit requests every memory topic and other project files without a clear relevance or redaction boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Request only outreach-related excerpts and instruct users to redact credentials, personal information, and unrelated client data before sharing.

content.user_title: Configure BeReach and Review Outreach Memory
content.value_statement: Conflicting saved rules can make outreach drafts inconsistent. This skill checks BeReach setup, reviews outreach instructions, and guides cleanup after user approval.
actual_capabilities: Check BeReach connector status and provide plan or connection setup guidance.
Identify missing companion outreach skills and describe installation options.
Inventory saved voice, offering, persona, and previous targeting information.
Classify observed outreach rules as keep, move, or delete.
Guide approved memory updates and direct users through manual cleanup.
Present setup checks and rule reviews using the bundled artifact layouts.
limitations: BeReach tool access and an eligible plan are needed for connected operations.
Complete rule evaluation depends on companion outreach skills not bundled here.
Unavailable memories and project instructions require user-provided excerpts.
Account memory cleanup may require manual actions; referenced remote setup instructions can change.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New Outreach Workspace
use_cases.description: Check connectivity, identify missing skills, and inventory saved outreach information before drafting messages.

use_cases.title: Resolve Conflicting Client Instructions
use_cases.description: Review relevant project rules and propose approved changes while keeping each client's voice and offering information separate.

use_cases.title: Review a Local Claude Code Setup
use_cases.description: Inspect skill availability, review accessible outreach instructions, and choose project-local or account-wide installation guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my BeReach connection and available outreach skills. Show what is missing without changing configuration or memory.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Outreach Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit only these outreach-related rules: [redacted excerpts]. Classify each as keep, move, or delete, explain why, and wait for approval.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Approved Memory Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply only my approved changes: [changes]. Preserve existing offering details and save replacement voice information before removing old entries.

prompt_templates.title: Review Setup and Language Boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my setup for [languages]. Preview remote setup steps for approval, separate language-specific voice records, and verify approved cleanup without changing unrelated instructions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: multilingual setup and cleanup review

output_examples.input: Check my setup without changing anything.
output: Outreach method, personas, and voice skills are available; the messages skill is missing.
Voice information is available in French; offering information has not been inspected.
No configuration or memory changes were made.

output_examples.input: Review these two rules: always ask for a meeting; use formal French greetings.
output: Illustrative rule review, assuming companion skill guidance is available:
Delete proposal: Always ask for a meeting conflicts with the messages skill.
Move proposal: Formal French greetings belong in the French Voice card.
Awaiting approval. Nothing has been deleted.

best_practices: Share only relevant, redacted outreach rules and verify which information the assistant actually inspected.
Review remote setup instructions and confirm configuration changes before installation.
Approve specific cleanup actions and preserve replacement records before deleting existing entries.
anti_patterns: Pasting all account memories or client files without checking for sensitive information.
Deleting saved instructions before reviewing the proposed changes.
Treating unavailable companion skills or unseen memory as already inspected.

faq.question: What does this skill set up?
faq.answer: It checks BeReach connectivity and companion outreach skills, then reviews saved outreach rules and proposes cleanup.

faq.question: Does it require a BeReach plan?
faq.answer: Connected operations require BeReach access. The skill provides plan guidance when the status response indicates a plan is required.

faq.question: Can it inspect every account memory automatically?
faq.answer: No. It uses available context and tools. You must provide relevant excerpts from information it cannot access.

faq.question: Will it delete memories without approval?
faq.answer: The instructions require approval before cleanup. Some deletions must be performed manually, and a full memory reset requires an explicit request.

faq.question: Does it include the companion outreach skills?
faq.answer: No. It identifies missing outreach method, personas, voice, and messages skills and provides installation guidance.

faq.question: Can it keep separate writing preferences for multiple languages?
faq.answer: Yes. It directs voice information into one Voice card per language and delegates voice updates to the companion voice skill.
